body.title: Flush 2-line scrolling prompt + interrupt-hint placeholder (deltas 1+2)
body.summary: In renderShell (chat-panel.ts): edit the #insrc-input CSS (:303) to drop the border/border-radius/background box chrome and its :focus border-color rule, and add overflow-y:auto while keeping rows=2 (a flush 2-line scrolling prompt); change #insrc-prompt (:291) align-self:flex-end→flex-start so the ❯ leads the top line only; and change the #insrc-input placeholder (:510) to 'message claude… (⌘↵ send · ^C interrupt)'. Presentation-only; the #insrc-prompt id/role=button/tabindex and setRunning are untouched.
acceptanceChecks: renderShell's #insrc-input CSS has no border/border-radius/background box and includes overflow-y:auto, keeping rows=2
the #insrc-input placeholder equals 'message claude… (⌘↵ send · ^C interrupt)' and contains '^C interrupt'
#insrc-prompt keeps id + role=button + tabindex (S002 send/stop control unchanged)
